label: Helix
interpretation: Automatic relative-emission reconstruction from aligned outreach images, with a molecular velocity scaffold where available. Multiscale emission components, front/back allocation and outer-halo depth are conditional model assumptions. Image colors do not redefine the fitted field. Registered WFI, VISTA and wider optical residuals supply one bounded stellar union; the candidate budget includes observed compact cores outside the WFI footprint. App delivery explicitly selects a small image-anchor subset plus its independent Gaia field. Conditional emission-column depths are illustrative, not measured stellar distances or confirmed nebular membership.
